operations.command: set -e; for i in $(seq 1 300); do result=$(systemctl show -p Result --value nixos-recovery-boot-entry.service 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$result" = success ]; then break; fi; if [ "$result" = exit-code ]; then systemctl status nixos-recovery-boot-entry.service; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$(systemctl show -p Result --value nixos-recovery-boot-entry.service)" = success; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) fallback=BOOTX64.EFI ;; aarch64) fallback=BOOTAA64.EFI ;; *) fallback=BOOTUNKNOWN.EFI ;; esac; test -f /boot/loader/entries/nixos-recovery.conf; test -f /boot/EFI/recovery/nixos-recovery.efi; test -f /recovery/EFI/recovery/nixos-recovery.efi; test -f "/recovery/EFI/BOOT/$fallback"; bootctl list | grep -F nixos-recovery.conf; printf recovery-entry-ok
set -e; test "$(hostname)" = nixos-recovery; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/btrfs; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/cryptsetup; printf recovery-boot-ok
